interpretation: Plain Tor was classified with F1 0.913 (95% CI 0.722–1.000); persona cover with F1 0.919 (95% CI 0.774–1.000). The difference in F1 is smaller than 0.05 and inside the reported intervals, so this dataset does not support a claim either way. Cost: the median page load was 1.01x plain Tor and the cover overhead was 3.477x the page bytes. Constant-rate cover (B) scored F1 0.850 at 2.793x overhead; it is the baseline that persona cover has to beat on cost without giving up inference resistance.
